title: Etekcity 0.1g Food Kitchen Scale, Digital Ounces and Grams for Cooking, Baking, Meal Prep, Dieting, and Weight Loss, 11lb/5kg, Gray
description:
About this item
High-Precision: The high-sensitivity sensor offers accurate readings from 1 g-5 kg with dual increments: 1g-1 kg, 0.1 g; 1-5 kg, 1 g
Versatile: Easily switch unit among oz, lb, g, fl: oz, and ml. Tare button tells the exact weight of your item obviously
Hassle-Free: Sleek and compact design makes the scale easy to clean and store
Clear Display: The 2.5 x 1 in bright LCD display offers impressive visibility and readability
Thoughtfully Designed: Powered by two pre-installed AAA batteries, the scale will auto-off in 2 mins to extend battery life
› See more product details
reviews_5s:
I absolutely love this food scale! It’s incredibly accurate and easy to use. The digital display is clear, and I appreciate the tare function, which allows me to subtract the weight of containers for precise measurements. It’s perfect for portion control, baking, and meal prepping. The design is sleek and modern, and it fits easily in my kitchen without taking up much space. Plus, it’s simple to clean. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable, affordable scale!This works great!! Easy to use, easy to clean, love the different metrics. It’s small and I put it away easily when I’m done. I think it’s so cute and I love red appliances in my kitchen. I lost 20 pounds in 2.5 months just by weighing out my food!!!!!I bought this in gray and now in red for my second home. I’ve gotten it wet, dirty, and it works well. It’s super accurate to the decimal. It has very good battery life as well. The red version is cheaper than the other colors right now.I'm happy to see 5kg capacity and 0.1g resolution at this price point. The scale registers each addition quickly on the easy to read display. The pan is a good size but seems delicate, so I handle the unit carefully.Works great. Really accurate.Inexpensive, versatile and accurate. Just what I needed in my kitchen. Very pleased.Nice little kitchen scale -- also good for home science experiements when you need to measure something small!
I also use this scale to measure yarn by weight when winding a large skein into two or more balls!
I took one of the scales into "school" so my students can easily measure the mass of materials they use for thermal experiments!Nothing more to add really.
Works as described.This scale is fast settling and has excellent resolution for the kitchen.
We use it the measure out dry food for our cats and it allows me to get a consistent weight very quickly.I needed a scale that went below measured to the 10th of a gram. This does the job nicely. If you need to measure less than 1gram I would suggest a micro scale.

I bought this scale because it advertised itself as starting to count tenths of grams starting at 0.5 grams. This scale starts counting grams at 1 full gram. If you’re doing homebrew or finicky baking, this is NOT your scale. I could not possibly recommend this to anyone.Click to play video
The first time when I bought this scale it worked for about 5 months. I did not check how precise it was. I thought ok, it is cheap and threw it away when it stopped working after about 5 months and bought another one. This time I needed a precision. This scale has a 0.1g increments (supposedly). I almost ruined my recipe because I was relying on this scale. It acted up weird. Then I just tested it. You can see it on the video.
